sentences.text: Retirement Relief in Quitting Service for the Construction Workers

**Scheme Brief Description:** The "Retirement Relief in Quitting Service for the Construction Workers'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, U.T. Administration of DNH & DD, is a welfare scheme that provides a certain amount to the eligible registered worker on quitting service after attaining age of 60 years.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Sector: Provident fund
**Where it applies:** Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu; State/ UT

**Detailed Description:** The &quot;Retirement Relief in Quitting Service for the Construction Workers&quot; by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, U.T. Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this scheme, the Board will provide a certain amount to the eligible registered worker who is a member of the Board for a continuous period of 15 years, on quitting service after attaining age of 60 years. <br>
**Benefits / Assistance:** **Quantum of Assistance:** A certain amount would be paid to the Construction Workers/ Beneficiary, who is the member of the Board for a continuous period of 15 years. <br>

**Application Process:** > **Registration Process as a Building/ Construction Worker:** **Step 1:** Application for registration is to be made in the prescribed form and is to be accompanied by prescribed documents and a fee of not more than ₹50/-. **Step 2:** Application for registration has to be made to the officer authorized by the Board on this behalf. > **Application Process of the Welfare Scheme:** **Step 1:** A registered worker should request a prescribed format for the application from the officer authorized by the Board and should attach all the mandatory documents (self attested, if required). **Step 2:** Application shall be submitted to the Member Secretary (BOCWWB) for this benefit. &gt; **Helpdesk:** BOCW Department: EMAIL ID: labour-dnh@nic.in PHONE NUMBER : 0260 - 2642374 ADDRESS: Old Circuit House Building, Opposite Bal Bhawan, Silvassa, Dadra and Nagar Haveli Pin:- 396230
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Labour & Employment Department
